title: Verification check runner
responsibility: Runs a planned check or declared tool in the snapshot under resource admission and process isolation, gathers bounded evidence, and returns its result.

inputs.name: CheckRunService.constructor.context
inputs.description: Provides a clean snapshot, scratch directory, commit and tree, profile, environment, and optional capture byte caps. The runner defaults HARNESS_RESOURCE_PRIORITY to 'environment' when that environment key is absent; absent capture limits impose no cap.

inputs.name: CheckRunService.run.check
inputs.description: A planned unit, integration, or end-to-end check with the command, snapshot-relative working directory, and time limit to run. Its ID determines the log name and evidence leaf, while an optional scenario scopes the evidence path and prefixes failures.

inputs.name: CheckRunService.version.tool
inputs.description: A declared tool identifier and shell command, run from the snapshot root with the run environment. The identifier names the tool log, whose first nonempty trimmed line is returned when the command passes.

outputs.name: CheckRunService.run
outputs.description: Resolves to the planned check, its recorded test entry, gathered evidence captures, and any execution or capture failure messages. It passes only when the isolated command passed and no failure messages were recorded.

outputs.name: CheckRunService.version
outputs.description: Resolves to the first nonempty trimmed line of the tool log when the isolated command passes; otherwise it resolves to undefined. A missing, unreadable, or empty log also yields undefined.

errors.name: ZodError
errors.description: The run rejects with ZodError when HARNESS_RESOURCE_PRIORITY is outside 'agent-test', 'coding', or 'environment', or when resourceWork's resource request fails schema parsing.

errors.name: Check run resource admission failure
errors.description: The run rejects with Error when resource admission cannot establish the owner, the queue is full, or an inherited lease is invalid or too small; log-directory or log-file creation failures also propagate.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: The scenario-scoped frozen video context exceeds its fixed process-environment metadata cap.
